title: "Front-loading panel (Figure 4c)"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Figure 4c: share of heat-responsive genes expressed more highly in urban than reef colonies under control conditions
(contemporary pH, ambient temperature), compared with the permutation null (habitat labels shuffled among colonies,
5,000 times). Inputs are the colony-level permutation tables written by the front-loading chunks of the two limma
scripts; nothing is refitted here.

```{r frontloading-panel, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2}
library(ggplot2)

read_fl <- function(sp, label) {
  d <- read.csv(sprintf("../../outputs/transcriptomics/%s/limma/frontloading_permutation.csv", sp))
  d$species <- label
  d
}
fl <- rbind(read_fl("ofav", "O. faveolata"), read_fl("ssid", "S. siderea"))
fl$gene_set <- factor(fl$gene_set, levels = c("heat_up", "heat_down"),
                      labels = c("Heat-upregulated", "Heat-downregulated"))
fl$species <- factor(fl$species, levels = c("O. faveolata", "S. siderea"))
fl$p_lab <- ifelse(fl$p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste("p =", signif(fl$p, 2)))
fl$n_lab <- sprintf("%s genes", format(fl$genes, big.mark = ","))
fl

p_fl <- ggplot(fl, aes(x = gene_set)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = null_2.5, ymax = null_97.5), linewidth = 6, colour = "grey85") + # permutation null, 95% range
  geom_point(aes(y = share_higher_in_urban_at_control), size = 3, colour = "#a6611a") +
  geom_text(aes(y = share_higher_in_urban_at_control, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share_higher_in_urban_at_control)),
            nudge_x = 0.28, size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 0.07, label = p_lab), size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 0.01, label = n_lab), size = 2.8, colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = function(x) 100 * x) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Urban > reef (% genes)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"))
print(p_fl)
dir.create("../../outputs/transcriptomics/frontloading", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("../../outputs/transcriptomics/frontloading/frontloading_panel.pdf", p_fl, width = 7, height = 3.2)
```
